headline: US crude oil inventories rise by 1.1 million barrels, stockpiles below five-year average
summary: US crude oil inventories increased during the week ending November 20, reaching 418.9 million barrels, now 3% below the five-year average.
why: Changes in US oil inventories impact global oil supply expectations and energy markets, influencing prices and energy sector investments.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: US inventory levels influence global oil prices.
